job.job_description:
OpenObserve is a leading player in the world of open source observability tools, backed by renowned venture capitalists such as Nexus Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital. With our unique offering of combining logs, metrics, and traces into a single platform, weve made our mark in the tech industry. OpenObserve is the only tool that comes with a single binary that enables anyone to get started in less than 2 minutes. OpenObserve is proudly a fully remote team with team members spread across the globe.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality applications. They will also be responsible for designing and implementing testable and scalable code.
Responsibilities
Develop quality software and web applications
Analyse and maintain existing software applications
Design highly scalable, testable code
Discover and fix programming bugs
Requirements
Bachelors degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or related field.
5+ Years of experience in Distributed Systems.
Development experience with Rust.
Experience with low systems level programming is desirable.
Experience building databases in rust is desirable.
Experience with Apache arrow datafusion is highly desirable.
SQL database or relational database skills.
Experience with cloud and Kubernetes is desirable.
Experience in observability is highly desirable.
Benefits
Competitive salary and benefits package
Stock options
Opportunity to work with a cutting-edge technology and contribute to the growth of a fast-paced startup
Collaborative and dynamic work environment with a team of passionate professionals
Flexible remote work arrangements
Professional development opportunities and training budget
Access to the latest tools and technologies
Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance
